learning_outcomes.text: Understand fundamental thermodynamic concepts and methodologies for describing substance and energy transformation processes.
Reduce energy systems abstractly to simple idealized, yet realistic systems and describe them mathematically.
Calculate and evaluate simple energy processes.
Assess the quality of different energy forms and their conversion.
Make planning decisions based on evaluation criteria.
Students can thermodynamically analyze and optimize technical designs.

syllabus_topics: State variables and equations of state
1st law of thermodynamics – work, heat, internal energy, enthalpy
Changes of state of ideal gases
2nd law of thermodynamics – reversible and irreversible processes, entropy, entropy change and generation
Technically important cycle processes with gases – Otto process, Diesel process, gas turbine process
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam (grade).
